data.description:
## Context / Problem

The parent epic needs one configuration option that selects the plan-review engine, so a project can run either today's 4-pass pipeline or the single-agent review, and both can be compared on the same ticket. Today every review goes through `orchestrator` (`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/orchestrator.py`) with no selection point. The switch is a temporary mechanism: it exists only until one engine is retired, so its `mechanism-ok` marker must name an open sunset ticket.

## Approach

Add the key ADR 0123 records, `[verify] plan_review_engine` with values `"pipeline"` and `"agentic"` and default `"pipeline"`, declared beside the other plan-review keys in `src/rebar/_config_schema.py` (`require_plan_review_for_close`, line 71) and validated in `src/rebar/_config_sections.py` (line 56 pattern), so an unknown value is a config error at load time, never a silent fallback. Resolve the engine once per review with the ADR's precedence: an explicit `engine` argument on `review_plan` (`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py:199`), else the config key, else `"pipeline"`, and pass it as a workflow input to `gate_dispatch.produce_plan_review_verdict` (`__init__.py:522`).

Selection lives in the plan-review workflow, `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml`. Its `precheck` step (line 49) runs the deterministic Layer-1 floor and sets `run_llm`, and the `review` step (line 53) runs only `when: steps.precheck.outputs.run_llm`; claimability already fast-fails earlier, in `_run_plan_review` (`__init__.py:396-400`, `claimability.not_claimable_verdict`). This ticket adds `engine == 'pipeline'` to the `review` step's condition and nothing else, so a floor block or a not-claimable ticket returns before any engine is consulted and the result is byte-identical under both values. Because this lands before the agentic engine exists, `"agentic"` passes validation but `review_plan` raises a config error naming the value and saying the engine is not yet available; the agentic-engine ticket that follows replaces that raise with its workflow step. No half-wired path can run.

The definition site carries `# mechanism-ok: config_key verify.plan_review_engine — bossy-impish-hoiho`, naming the open sunset ticket under the epic, the only kind and name the marker admits (AGENTS.md, mechanism-delta ratchet). A single resolved value at one dispatch point is the narrowest seam: every surface (CLI, library, MCP) already funnels into the review entry point, so they inherit the switch without their own branch.

## Scope

- rebar.toml (`[verify] plan_review_engine = "pipeline"`, commented)
- src/rebar/_config_schema.py (key declaration)
- src/rebar/_config_sections.py (value validation)
- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py (`review_plan` engine argument and resolution)
- src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py (engine workflow input)
- src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml (`review` step condition)
- docs/config.md (key documented)
- tests/unit/test_plan_review_engine_switch.py (new)

## Testing

- Happy path: with no key set the pipeline runs; with `"pipeline"` set the pipeline runs; an explicit `engine="pipeline"` argument overrides a configured `"agentic"`.
- Failure/edge: an unknown value raises a config error naming the value; a ticket that fails the Layer-1 floor and a not-claimable ticket each make zero LLM calls under both values, asserted with `FakeRunner` (`src/rebar/llm/runner.py:194`) call counts, and return identical verdict and findings.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `[verify] plan_review_engine` is read with default `"pipeline"`, explicit-argument precedence, and an error on unknown values; pinned by `tests/unit/test_plan_review_engine_switch.py`.
- [ ] Floor-blocked and not-claimable reviews make zero LLM calls and return identical results under both values; pinned by call-counting tests in the same file.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exits 0 with the marker naming the open sunset ticket.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Plan-review engine switch: [verify] plan_review_engine, dispatched after the Layer-1 floor
